title: Add exact rank-7 stage-three moment crossing audit
body:
## Summary

Add `research/rank7-stage3-moment-crossing/`, a source-bound, exact arithmetic audit of PR2979's fourteen-rewrite stage-3 profile transition on the final T74 fill.

The verifier uses integer 32nd-root bisection and adjacent alternating generalized-binomial partial sums. It imports neither of PR2979's moment functions and avoids logarithms, exponentials, floating point and decimal proof decisions.

## Result

At PR2979's claimed saving, retaining the final fill and replacing only the local profile with the published stage-2 profile gives

```text
M_after  < 1 < M_before
```

The exact interval check displays `M_after ≈ 0.9999999999999999999999983206044259838` and `M_before ≈ 1.0000034798427407506060437871818665415`. The exact upper bound for `M_after - M_before` is negative. Source binding, the prior-headline controls, zero-saving mass, omitted-transition, extra-rank, overclaim and byte-corruption controls pass.

This is one arithmetic implication for a source-declared profile change. It does not validate the word rewrite, owner geometry, physical invoice, supplier admission, or selected frontier; it gives no new κ.

## Validation

- `python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py` — `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`.
- `python3.12 -B research/rank7-stage3-moment-crossing/verify.py --write-result` — `PASS_RANK7_STAGE3_BINOMIAL_MOMENT_CROSSING`.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-stage3-moment-crossing --check-only` — metadata and pin check passed.
- `python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rank7-stage3-moment-crossing --check-source-history` — passed on package commit `fe56c52184445a0009b8aa77ce8c29006379fb1e`.
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-stage3-moment-crossing` — `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE outcome=completed` on final commit `fe56c52184445a0009b8aa77ce8c29006379fb1e`.

## Source and credit

The inputs pin canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, PR2979 source head `be191346391661f4d35fc0d1508d0a6029572576`, and the PR2957 rewrite lineage. Credit Marius-Paul Dumitrean and the retained source authors, including Jeremy Kothe for PR2957. The independent enclosure is new here; substantial AI assistance was used. Independent human and formal-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-stage3-moment-crossing` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rank7-stage3-moment-crossing --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.
